name: whoop-mcp
description: Read-only access to your WHOOP recovery, HRV, sleep, strain, workouts and trends.
long_description:
Ask about your WHOOP recovery, HRV, sleep, strain and workouts. Everything is **read-only**: only WHOOP's `read:*` scopes are requested, and the server can only send GET requests.

**One-time setup**

1. Create a WHOOP developer app at https://developer-dashboard.whoop.com/apps/create with all `read:*` scopes and the redirect URI `http://localhost:8787/callback`.
2. In a terminal, run `npx -y @oryanomer/whoop-mcp auth` and paste the app's Client ID and Secret. Approve access in your browser.
3. Install this extension. It reads the tokens saved in step 2 and refreshes them automatically.

Tokens stay on your computer, and data is fetched only from WHOOP's official API.

Privacy policy: https://github.com/oryanomer1/whoop-mcp/blob/main/PRIVACY.md
Terms of use (EULA): https://github.com/oryanomer1/whoop-mcp/blob/main/EULA.md

Full documentation: https://github.com/oryanomer1/whoop-mcp
